projects.title: Vendor integrations for a background-screening platform
projects.description: Integration layer of a microservice-based platform that routes background-screening orders (identity, Right to Work, criminal, employment and education checks) to third-party vendors and has processed over 1M orders. I defined the shared connector interface, build vendor integrations end to end and built the monitoring service that health-checks connectors and removes failing ones from routing.

image.alt: Vendor integrations for a background-screening platform

projects.title: Internal platform for a law firm
projects.description: The platform the firm ran on: lead intake, client portal, case management, court calendar and invoicing for up to 150 employees across 10,000+ legal cases. Automated claim preparation cut it from several days to about an hour. From 2020 I led the team of 4 developers behind it.

image.alt: Internal platform for a law firm

projects.title: CRM/ERP for a US door distributor
projects.description: As the sole developer, built a system used by about 30 employees: sales pipeline, dealer pricing, product configurator with PDF quotes, orders, inventory and shipping. Integrations with QuickBooks Online, Zoho CRM, Mailchimp, PayPal and Authorize.Net mean quotes take minutes instead of hours and nothing is entered twice.

image.alt: CRM/ERP for a US door distributor

projects.title: Event-venue booking startup
projects.description: As CTO, co-founder and lead engineer, took the platform from zero to production on AWS. It reached about 200 listed venues and, together with the CMO, top Google rankings, and the company raised seed investment.
